author: Linton C. Freeman
title: A Set of Measures of Centrality Based on Betweenness
relation: Shortest-path mediation motivates structural importance. Original vertex centrality is not a robust edge-protection objective; this study adapts the idea to edge priorities.

author: Ulrik Brandes
title: A Faster Algorithm for Betweenness Centrality
relation: Dependency accumulation computes unweighted centrality in O(VE) arithmetic operations; here it supplies a cost-normalized heuristic, not an exact robust-flow solver.
